Then there is the 128-expert MoE. Figuring out how to handle routing for that without losing the context that makes these agents useful is the next big headache for framework maintainers.​

#LLMs #GenerativeAI​

Most frameworks are still hunting for tool calls hidden in markdown blocks. Gemma 4, however, uses native tokens like <|start_of_tool_call|> to trigger actions. If your parser isn’t looking for those specific signals yet, the agent just sits there.

#AgenticWorkflows​

It's fast. Running it locally doesn't result in the usual sluggishness 
or the hardware struggling to keep up. Usually, running a model this size means choosing between a jet-engine fan or a massive drop-off in logic. ​Gemma 4 manages to stay capable without either. 

#LocalAI
